df = pd.concat([df3, df4], ignore_index=True)

print('date parse ok count:', df['d'].notna().sum(), 'of', len(df))
print('sample dates:', df['d'].dropna().head(5).tolist())

# money parse
def parse_money(v):
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)): return float(v)
    s = str(v).strip().replace('.', '').replace(',', '').replace('đ','').replace('tr','000000').replace('tr0','000000')
    # handle '1tr440'
    import re
    s = str(v).strip()
    neg = s.startswith('-')
    s = s.replace('-','')
    # thousands 'tr'
    s = s.replace('tr','000000')
    s = s.replace('.', '').replace(',', '')
    val = float(s)
    return -val if neg else val

df['money'] = df['Tiền'].apply(parse_money)
print('money sample:', df['money'].head(10).tolist())

# status normalize

    s = str(s).strip()
    if s in ('hủy','Hủy'): return False
    if s in ('trả lại','Đã trả hàng'): return False

neg = good[good['Số lượng hàng'].astype(str).str.contains('-', na=False)]

    s=s.replace('đ','').replace('.','').replace(',','')
    m=re.match(r'^(\d+(?:\d*)tr)?(\d+)$', s)
    if not m:
        # fallback: any 'tr'
        parts=s.split('tr')
        a=parts[0]; b=parts[1] if len(parts)>1 else '0'

        else:

    return -float(val) if neg else float(val)

import pandas as pd
df3 = pd.read_excel('SoBanHang.xlsx', sheet_name='Tháng 03-2025')
df4 = pd.read_excel('SoBanHang.xlsx', sheet_name='Tháng 04-2025')
df = pd.concat([df3, df4], ignore_index=True)

def parse_money(v):
    if isinstance(v,(int,float)): return float(v)
    s=str(v).strip()
    neg=s.startswith('-'); s=s.replace('-','')
    s=s.replace('đ','').replace('.','').replace(',','')
    parts=s.split('tr')
    a=parts[0].strip(); b=parts[1].strip() if len(parts)>1 else ''
    try:
        val=int(a)*1000000 + int(b)*1000 if a or b else 0
    except:
        try: val=int(s)
        except: return float('nan')
    return -float(val) if neg else float(val)

df['money']=df['Tiền'].apply(parse_money)
print('NaN money:', df['money'].isna().sum())
print('money min/max:', df['money'].min(), df['money'].max())
big=df[df['money'].abs()>1e9]
print('big:', big['Tiền'].tolist(), big['money'].tolist())

def status_ok(s):
    s=str(s).strip()
    if s in ('hủy','Hủy'): return False
    if s in ('trả lại','Đã trả hàng'): return False
    return True
df['ok']=df['Ghi chú TT'].apply(status_ok)

start=pd.Timestamp('2025-03-27'); end=pd.Timestamp('2025-04-25')
sub=df[(df['d']>=start)&(df['d']<=end)]
good=sub[sub['ok']]
neg=good[good['Số lượng hàng'].astype(str).str.contains('-', na=False)]
print('rows in window:', len(sub), 'good rows:', len(good), 'neg qty in good:', len(neg))
print('revenue:', round(good['money'].sum()))
print('by status:', good['Ghi chú TT'].value_counts().to_dict())
